dog.description_text:
Meet Mars, a lively pup whose charm is out of this world!

Mars is a handsome boy who brings curiosity and excitement wherever his little paws take him. Mars continues to gain confidence as he explores new environments, learning from his human companions and dog friends that the world isn’t such a scary place after all! Now, when the leash comes out, Mars is bursting with joy at the prospect of a new adventure.

Mars' enthusiasm is contagious, especially during playtime. This boy is all about the ruff-and-tumble with his favorite canine companions. When he’s not romping around with other pups, Mars is probably cozying up to his people, leaning in for a nice massage and wiggling like crazy every time you say his name. This bouncy boy is just so full of affection, he can hardly contain it!

If you’re looking for a sweet companion who will greet you with pure excitement every time you walk through the door, Mars is your guy. Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about this charming young man!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
